entries.name: Blazing Barrier
entries.description:
Blazing BarrierTalent3% of base manaInstant30 sec cooldown1 ChargeRequires MageShields you in flame, absorbing [30 / 100 * Total Health * (1 + Versatility)] damage [Molten Skin: and reducing Physical damage taken by 0%] for 1 min.

Melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take (14.375% of Spell Power) Fire damage.

entries.name: Alter Time
entries.description: Alter TimeTalent1% of base manaInstant1 min cooldownRequires MageAlters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.

entries.name: Ice Block
entries.description:
Ice BlockTalentInstant4 min cooldown1 ChargeRequires MageEncases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

entries.name: Time Walk
entries.description: Time WalkTalentRequires MageAlter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.

entries.name: Temporal Realignment
entries.description: Temporal RealignmentTalentRequires MageUpon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 20% of your maximum health and healing you for an additional 30% over 6 sec.

entries.name: Master of Time
entries.description:
Master of TimeTalentRequires MageRequires level 25
Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 5 sec.

entries.name: Winter's Protection
entries.description: Winter's ProtectionTalentRequires MageThe cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 30 sec.

entries.name: Frost Conditioning
entries.description: Frost ConditioningTalentRequires MageHypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.

entries.name: Arcane Warding
entries.description: Arcane WardingTalentRequires MageReduces magic damage taken by 4%.

entries.name: Inspired Intellect
entries.description: Inspired IntellectTalentRequires MageArcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.

entries.name: Mirror Image
entries.description:
Mirror ImageTalent2% of base manaInstant2 min cooldownRequires MageCreates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate. (2s cooldown)

entries.name: Spellsteal
entries.description: SpellstealTalent21% of base mana40 yd rangeInstantRequires MageSteals [Kleptomania: all beneficial magic effects from the target. These effects lasts a maximum of 2 min / a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min].

entries.name: Quick Witted
entries.description: Quick WittedTalentRequires MageCounterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

entries.name: Dragon's Breath
entries.description:
Dragon's BreathTalent4% of base manaInstant45 sec cooldownRequires MageEnemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take (66.99% of Spell Power) Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.

Fire
Always deals a critical strike and contributes to Hot Streak.

entries.name: Supernova
entries.description:
SupernovaTalent40 yd rangeInstant45 sec cooldownRequires MageRequires level 45
Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing (34.5% of Spell Power) Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.

entries.name: Remove Curse
entries.description: Remove CurseTalent1.3% of base mana40 yd rangeInstant8 sec cooldownRequires MageRemoves all Curses from a friendly target.

entries.name: Improved Conjuration
entries.description: Improved ConjurationTalentRequires MageMirror Image's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

entries.name: Improved Spellsteal
entries.description: Improved SpellstealTalentRequires MageSpellsteal repeats its effect after 4 sec, but it now has a cooldown of 4.0 sec.

entries.name: Shimmer
entries.description:
ShimmerTalentReplaces Blink
2% of base manaInstant30 sec cooldown1 ChargeRequires MageRequires level 25
Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.

entries.name: Improved Blink
entries.description: Improved BlinkTalentRequires Mage[Shimmer / Blink]'s cooldown is reduced by 2 sec.

entries.name: Improved Counterspell
entries.description: Improved CounterspellTalentRequires MageCounterspell prevents casting for an additional 1.0 sec.

entries.name: Overflowing Energy
entries.description:
Overflowing EnergyTalentRequires Mage Arcane
Each time your Arcane Barrage fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.

 Fire
Each time your Fireball fails to critically strike, it gains 20% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.

 Frost
Each time your Frostbolt fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.

entries.name: Improved Remove Curse
entries.description: Improved Remove CurseTalentRequires MageCasting Remove Curse on a friendly target also casts it on yourself, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.

entries.name: Greater Invisibility
entries.description: Greater InvisibilityTalentInstant2 min cooldownRequires MageMakes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.

entries.name: Improved Frost Nova
entries.description: Improved Frost NovaTalentRequires MageFrost Nova duration is increased by 2 sec.

entries.name: Ice Ward
entries.description:
Ice WardTalentRequires MageRequires level 40
Frost Nova now has 2 charges.

entries.name: Captured Thoughts
entries.description:
Captured ThoughtsTalentRequires Mage Frost
The duration of Brain Freeze is increased by 15 sec.

 Arcane
The duration of Clearcasting is increased by 10 sec.

 Fire
The duration of Hot Streak is increased by 15 sec.

entries.name: Tome of Rhonin
entries.description: Tome of RhoninTalentRequires MageIncreases critical strike chance by 2%.

entries.description: Improved WardingTalentRequires MageDamage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.

entries.name: Tome of Antonidas
entries.description: Tome of AntonidasTalentRequires MageIncreases Haste by 2%.

entries.description: Incantation of SwiftnessTalentRequires Mage[Greater Invisibility: Greater]Invisibility increases your movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.

entries.description: Master of EscapeTalentRequires MageReduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.

BrainstormTalentRequires Mage Frost
Gaining Brain Freeze increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.

 Arcane
Gaining Clearcasting increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.

 Fire
Gaining Hot Streak increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.

entries.name: Flow of Time
entries.description: Flow of TimeTalentRequires MageThe cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.

entries.name: Mana Confluence
entries.description: Mana ConfluenceTalentRequires MageYour mana costs are reduced by 5%.

entries.name: Charm of Medivh
entries.description: Charm of MedivhTalentRequires MageYour Mastery is increased by 3%.

entries.name: Permafrost Bauble
entries.description: Permafrost BaubleTalentRequires MageThe cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.

entries.name: Freezing Cold
entries.description:
Freezing ColdTalentRequires MageEnemies hit by Cone of Cold are frozen in place for 5 sec instead of snared.

When your roots expire or are dispelled, your target is snared by 80%, decaying over 3 sec.

entries.name: Ice Nova
entries.description:
Ice NovaTalent40 yd rangeInstant25 sec cooldownRequires MageRequires level 15
Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing (138% of Spell Power) Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

entries.name: Time Manipulation
entries.description: Time ManipulationTalentRequires MageThe cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.

entries.name: Ring of Frost
entries.description:
Ring of FrostTalent8% of base mana30 yd range2 sec cast45 sec cooldownRequires MageRequires level 40
Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.

When the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.

entries.name: Mass Polymorph
entries.description:
Mass PolymorphTalent4% of base mana1.7 sec cast1 min cooldownRequires MageTransforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.

Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

entries.name: Energized Barriers
entries.description: Energized BarriersTalentRequires MageCasting your barrier removes all snare effects.

entries.name: Mass Invisibility
entries.description:
Mass InvisibilityTalent6% of base manaInstant5 min cooldownRequires MageYou and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.

Does not affect allies in combat.

entries.name: Barrier Diffusion
entries.description: Barrier DiffusionTalentRequires MageWhen your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.

entries.name: Ice Cold
entries.description: Ice ColdTalentRequires MageIce Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.

entries.name: Spatial Manipulation
entries.description: Spatial ManipulationTalentRequires Mage[Shimmer / Blink] gains an additional charge.

entries.name: Reflection
entries.description:
ReflectionTalentRequires MageAfter casting [Shimmer / Blink], it is replaced with Reflection for 8 sec.

 Reflection
Teleports you back to where you last [Shimmer: Shimmered / Blinked]. Castable while casting and unaffected by the global cooldown.

entries.name: Improved Blazing Barrier
entries.description: Improved Blazing BarrierTalentRequires MageBlazing Barrier gains an additional charge and cauterizes your wounds, healing you for 15% of the damage it absorbs.

entries.name: Pyroblast
entries.description: PyroblastTalent1.5% of base mana40 yd range4 sec castRequires MageHurls an immense fiery boulder that causes (638.8% of Spell Power) Fire damage.

entries.name: Fire Blast
entries.description:
Fire BlastTalent1% of base mana40 yd rangeInstant14 sec cooldown1 ChargeRequires MageBlasts the enemy, critically striking for [(98.625% of Spell Power) * 2] Fire damage.

Castable while casting other spells.

entries.name: Firestarter
entries.description:
FirestarterTalentRequires MageRequires level 15
Your Fireball and Pyroblast spells always deal a critical strike when the target is above 90% health.

entries.name: Flamestrike
entries.description:
FlamestrikeTalent1.5% of base mana40 yd range3.5 sec castRequires MageCalls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for (345% of Spell Power) Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at a selected location.

Fire
Leaves behind a patch of flames that burns enemies within it for (6 * (15% of Spell Power)) Fire damage over 6 sec.

entries.name: Flamestrike
entries.description:
FlamestrikeTalent1.5% of base mana40 yd range3.5 sec castRequires MageCalls down a pillar of fire on your target, burning all enemies within the area for (345% of Spell Power) Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at your target.

Fire
Leaves behind a patch of flames that burns enemies within it for (6 * (15% of Spell Power)) Fire damage over 6 sec.

entries.name: Ignition
entries.description:
IgnitionTalentRequires MageFire Blast now spreads 50% of your target's Ignite to 1 enemy.

Flamestrike applies 15% more Ignite.

entries.name: Combustion
entries.description:
CombustionTalent10% of base manaInstant2 min cooldownRequires MageEngulfs you in flames for 10 sec, increasing your spells' critical strike chance by 100%.
[
Additionally, increases your spell damage by 0%.]

Castable while casting other spells.

Fire
Additionally, increases your Mastery by 75% of your critical strike chance.

entries.name: Fuel the Fire
entries.description:
Fuel the FireTalentRequires MageFlamestrike has a chance equal to 100% of your spell critical strike chance to build up to a Hot Streak.

Flamestrike deals 5% increased damage for each enemy it damages, up to 25%.

entries.name: Fervent Flickering
entries.description: Fervent FlickeringTalentRequires MageFire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Cauterize
entries.description:
CauterizeTalentRequires MageFatal damage instead brings you to 35% health and then burns you for 28% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

While burning, movement slowing effects are suppressed and your movement speed is increased by 150%.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 min.

entries.name: Meteor
entries.description:
MeteorTalent1% of base mana40 yd rangeInstant45 sec cooldownRequires MageCalls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing (900% of Spell Power) Fire damage to all enemies, and burns the ground, dealing [8 * (104% of Spell Power)] Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies in the area.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

entries.name: Scorch
entries.description:
ScorchTalent1% of base mana40 yd range1.5 sec castRequires MageScorches an enemy for (100% of Spell Power) Fire damage.

When cast on a target below 30% health, Scorch is a guaranteed critical strike.

Castable while moving.

entries.name: Flame On
entries.description:
Flame OnTalentRequires MageRequires level 35
Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.

entries.name: Kindling
entries.description: KindlingTalentRequires MageCombustion's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.

entries.name: Critical Mass
entries.description:
Critical MassTalentRequires MageYour spells have a 4% increased chance to deal a critical strike.

You gain 10% more of the Critical Strike stat from all sources.

entries.name: Deep Impact
entries.description: Deep ImpactTalentRequires MageThe enemy closest to the center of Meteor's impact takes 75% increased damage.

entries.name: Heat Shimmer
entries.description: Heat ShimmerTalentRequires MageApproximately 3 procs per minuteWhile Combustion is not active, damage from Ignite has a small chance to make your next Scorch instant, deal 100% increased damage, and deal damage as though your target was below 30% health.

entries.name: Scald
entries.description:
ScaldTalentRequires MageFireball always critically strikes enemies below 30% health.

When Fireball or Scorch damage an enemy below 30% health, Fireball deals 25% increased damage and Scorch deals 250% increased damage.

entries.name: Controlled Destruction
entries.description: Controlled DestructionTalentRequires MageDamaging an enemy with Fireball, Pyroblast, or Flamestrike increases the damage it receives from Ignite by 0.2%. Stacks up to 50 times.

entries.name: Mote of Flame
entries.description: Mote of FlameTalentRequires MageAll Fire damage dealt increased by 3%.

entries.name: Blast Zone
entries.description: Blast ZoneTalentRequires MageMeteor's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

entries.name: Conflagration
entries.description: ConflagrationTalentRequires MageFire Blast deals (40% of Spell Power) additional Fire damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.

entries.name: Intensifying Flame
entries.description: Intensifying FlameTalentRequires MageWhile Ignite is on 3 or fewer enemies it flares up dealing an additional 30% of its damage to affected targets.

entries.name: Spontaneous Combustion
entries.description: Spontaneous CombustionTalentRequires MageCasting Combustion refreshes up to 1 charge of Fire Blast.

entries.name: Molten Fury
entries.description: Molten FuryTalentRequires MageDamage dealt to targets below 35% health is increased by 15%.

entries.name: Inflame
entries.description: InflameTalentRequires MageHot Streak increases the amount of Ignite damage from Pyroblast or Flamestrike by an additional 25%.

entries.name: Wildfire
entries.description: WildfireTalentRequires MageFire Blast damage increased by 10% and it now spreads Ignite to 1 additional target.

entries.name: Fevered Incantation
entries.description: Fevered IncantationTalentRequires MageEach consecutive critical strike you deal increases critical strike damage you deal by 1%, up to 4% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Fire's Ire
entries.description:
Fire's IreTalentRequires MageYour spell critical strike chance is increased by 2.5%.

Combustion increases your critical strike damage by 2.5%.

entries.name: Master of Flame
entries.description:
Master of FlameTalentRequires MageIgnite deals 15% more damage when Combustion is not active.

Fire Blast now spreads an additional 50% of your Ignite.

entries.name: From the Ashes
entries.description:
From the AshesTalentRequires MageRequires level 35
Fire Blast damage increased by 15%. 

Your direct damage spells reduce the cooldown of Fire Blast by 0.50 sec. (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Fiery Rush
entries.description: Fiery RushTalentRequires MageWhile Combustion is active, Fire Blast recharges 50% faster.

entries.name: Flame Accelerant
entries.description: Flame AccelerantTalentRequires MageThe cast time of Pyroblast and Flamestrike is reduced by 20%.

entries.name: Pyromaniac
entries.description:
PyromaniacTalentRequires MageCasting Pyroblast or Flamestrike while Hot Streak is active has a 6% chance to repeat the spell cast at 50% effectiveness.

This effect counts as consuming Hot Streak. (700ms cooldown)

entries.name: Burnout
entries.description: BurnoutTalentRequires MageWhen Combustion expires, all of your active Ignites explode, dealing 75% of their remaining damage.

entries.name: Feel the Burn
entries.description: Feel the BurnTalentRequires MageFire Blast increases your mastery by 2% for 4 sec. Multiple applications may overlap. (100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Slow Burn
entries.description:
Slow BurnTalentRequires MageCombustion grants mastery equal to 75% of your Critical Strike stat.

Combustion causes your spells to apply Ignite at 15% increased effectiveness.

entries.name: Burn It All
entries.description: Burn It AllTalentRequires MageCombustion grants you 10% increased spell damage plus an additional 20% of your critical strike chance as spell damage.

entries.name: Pyroclasm
entries.description:
PyroclasmTalentRequires MageConsuming Hot Streak has a 15% chance to make your next non-instant Pyroblast or Flamestrike cast within 20 sec deal 230% additional damage.

Maximum 2 stacks.

entries.name: Cinderstorm
entries.description: CinderstormTalent40 yd rangeRequires MageCasting Pyroblast or Flamestrike has a 8% chance to summon a storm of 5 cinders that pursue your target. Upon reaching your target, each cinder deals (200% of Spell Power) Fire damage, applies Ignite at 100% effectiveness, and spreads 50% of your Ignite to up to 1 nearby target.

nodes.name: Fired Up / Fired Up / Fired Up

entries.name: Fired Up
entries.description: Fired UpTalent40 yd rangeRequires MageConsuming Hot Streak has a 20% chance to grant you a stack of Fired Up, increasing your Fire damage by 2% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

entries.name: Fired Up
entries.description:
Fired UpTalent40 yd rangeRequires MageGaining Fired Up reduces the cooldown of Fire Blast by 2.5 sec.

All Fire damage dealt is increased by 5%.

entries.name: Fired Up
entries.description:
Fired UpTalent40 yd rangeRequires MageCombustion significantly increases your chance of gaining Fired Up, reducing each time you gain Fired Up.

Additionally Fired Up now extends Combustion's duration by 1.0 sec.

entries.name: Frostfire Bolt
entries.description:
Frostfire BoltTalent2% of base mana40 yd range1.75 sec castRequires MageLaunches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing (259.4% of Spell Power) Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 50%, and causing an additional (21.6% of Spell Power) Frostfire damage over 8 sec.

Frost
Applies 1 stack of Freezing.

entries.name: Imbued Warding
entries.description:
Imbued WardingTalentRequires Mage Fire
Blazing Barrier also casts an Ice Barrier at 25% effectiveness.

 Frost
Ice Barrier also casts a Blazing Barrier at 25% effectiveness.

entries.name: Meltdown
entries.description:
MeltdownTalentRequires MageYou melt slightly out of your Ice Block and Ice Cold, allowing you to move slowly during Ice Block and increasing your movement speed over time.

Ice Block and Ice Cold trigger a Blazing Barrier when they end.

entries.name: Frostfire Empowerment
entries.description:
Frostfire EmpowermentTalentRequires Mage Fire
Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

 Frost
Casting Frostfire spells has a 10% chance to activate Frostfire Empowerment, causing your next Frostfire Bolt to be instant cast, deal 60% increased damage, explode for 60% of its damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Damage from Frostfire Empowerment applies 1 stack of Freezing.

entries.name: Elemental Affinity
entries.description:
Elemental AffinityTalentRequires Mage Frost
The cooldown of Fire spells is reduced by 30%.

 Fire
The cooldown of Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes is reduced by 30%.

entries.name: Flame and Frost
entries.description:
Flame and FrostTalentRequires Mage Fire
Cauterize resets the cooldown of your Frost spells with a base cooldown shorter than 4 minutes when it activates.

 Frost
Ice Block and Ice Cold reset the cooldowns of your Fire spells.

entries.name: Duality
entries.description:
DualityTalentRequires Mage Frost
Casting Glacial Spike also casts a Pyroblast, dealing (881.3% of Spell Power) Fire damage.

 Fire
Casting Pyroblast has a 20% chance to also cast a Glacial Spike, dealing (366.24% of Spell Power) Frost damage.

entries.name: Heat Sink
entries.description:
Heat SinkTalentRequires Mage Fire
Fire Blast now deals Frostfire damage and its damage is increased by 15%.

 Frost
Flurry now deals Frostfire damage and its damage is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Thermal Conditioning
entries.description: Thermal ConditioningTalentRequires MageFrostfire Bolt's cast time is reduced by 10%.

entries.name: Severe Temperatures
entries.description: Severe TemperaturesTalentRequires MageFrostfire Empowerment stacks 1 additional time and it causes Frostfire Bolt to explode for an additional 20% of its damage.

entries.name: Dualcasting Adept
entries.description:
Dualcasting AdeptTalentRequires Mage Frost
Your Fire spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

Shatter damage increased by 40%.

Blizzard damage increased by 15%.

 Fire
Your Frost spells deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

Pyroblast damage increased by 15%.

Flamestrike damage increased by 15%.

entries.name: Molten Chill
entries.description:
Molten ChillTalentRequires Mage Fire
Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite at 10% increased effectiveness.

 Frost
Your Frostfire spells apply Ignite, dealing an additional 30% of their damage over 9 sec.

entries.name: Frostfire Infusion
entries.description:
Frostfire InfusionTalentRequires Mage Frost
Frostfire Bolt has an additional 5% chance to grant Brain Freeze.

The damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.

 Fire
Frostfire Bolt's critical strike chance is increased by 15%..

The damage of your Frost spells and Fire spells are increased by 4%.

entries.name: Flash Freezeburn
entries.description:
Flash FreezeburnTalentRequires Mage Frost
Glacial Spike damage increased by 15% and it now explodes on impact, dealing 25% of its damage to up to 5 nearby enemies.

Additionally, Glacial Spike now grants Frostfire Empowerment.

 Fire
Meteor's damage is increased by 25%.

Meteor now grants Frostfire Empowerment.

entries.name: Blast Radius
entries.description:
Blast RadiusTalentRequires Mage Frost
Comet Storm damage increased by 50%.

Meteor damage increased by 20%.

 Fire
Meteor damage increased by 20%.

Comet Storm damage increased by 20%.

entries.name: Elemental Conduit
entries.description:
Elemental ConduitTalentRequires Mage Fire
Comet Storm and Glacial Spike now apply Ignite.

Your Haste is increased by 2%.

 Frost
Meteor and Pyroblast now apply Ignite.

Your Haste is increased by 2%.

entries.name: Isothermic Core
entries.description:
Isothermic CoreTalentRequires Mage Frost
Comet Storm now also calls down a Meteor, dealing (900% of Spell Power) Fire damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Damage from Meteor Shatters 1 stacks of Freezing.

 Fire
Meteor now also calls down a Comet Storm, dealing [(92.8% of Spell Power) * 7] Frost damage to nearby enemies.

entries.name: Spellfire Spheres
entries.description:
Spellfire SpheresTalentRequires Mage Arcane
Casting a damaging spell has a 6% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.

 Fire
Consuming Hot Streak has a 12% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 1.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.

entries.name: Mana Cascade
entries.description:
Mana CascadeTalentRequires Mage Arcane
Casting Arcane Blast, Arcane Pulse, Arcane Barrage, or Prismatic Bolt grants you 0.5% Haste for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

 Fire
Consuming Hot Streak grants you 0.5% Haste for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

entries.name: Invocation: Arcane Phoenix
entries.description:
Invocation: Arcane PhoenixTalentRequires Mage Arcane
When you cast Arcane Surge, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

 Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Arcane Surge, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.

 Fire
When you cast Combustion, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

 Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Combustion, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.

entries.name: Burden of Power
entries.description:
Burden of PowerTalentRequires Mage Arcane
Arcane Blast damage increased by 30%.

Arcane Pulse damage increased by 20%.

 Fire
Pyroblast damage increased by 3%.

Flamestrike damage increased by 6%.

entries.name: Glorious Incandescence
entries.description:
Glorious IncandescenceTalentRequires Mage Arcane
Arcane Barrage summons 1 Meteorite for every 5 Arcane Salvo stacks consumed.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing (102% of Spell Power) Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.

 Fire
Generating a Spellfire Sphere causes your next cast of Fire Blast to call down a storm of 4 Meteorites on its target.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing (102% of Spell Power) Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.

entries.name: Merely a Setback
entries.description:
Merely a SetbackTalentRequires Mage Arcane
The bonuses provided by your Barrier spells persist at 100% effectiveness for an additional 8 sec after your Barrier is removed.

 Fire
The bonuses provided by your Barrier spells persist at 100% effectiveness for an additional 8 sec after your Barrier is removed.

Additionally, Cauterize no longer deals damage to you.

entries.name: Time Twist
entries.description: Time TwistTalentRequires MageThe cooldown of Alter Time is reduced by 10 sec.

entries.name: Codex of the Sunstriders
entries.description:
Codex of the SunstridersTalentRequires Mage Arcane
When your Arcane Phoenix is summoned, it consumes all your Spellfire Spheres.

Each Sphere consumed increases your spell damage during Arcane Surge by 1% and causes your Arcane Phoenix to cast an exceptional Arcane or Fire spell over its duration.

 Fire
When your Arcane Phoenix is summoned, it consumes all your Spellfire Spheres.

Each Sphere consumed increases your spell damage during Combustion by 1% and causes your Arcane Phoenix to cast an exceptional Arcane or Fire spell over its duration.

entries.name: Lessons in Debilitation
entries.description: Lessons in DebilitationTalentRequires MageYour Arcane Phoenix has picked up a few tricks, and will Spellsteal when it is summoned and when it expires.

entries.name: Explosive Potential
entries.description:
Explosive PotentialTalentRequires Mage Arcane
After casting Arcane Surge, your next Blink will cause a Blast Wave at your previous location, dealing (54.3375% of Spell Power) Fire damage, knocking enemies back 8 yds, and slowing them by 70% for 6 sec.
